title: [GMCP 203.002.05] Interoperability and quality: JSON-RPC, protocol metadata, errors, cancellation, and negotiation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-002-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: GMCP implements the complete JSON-RPC substrate for every supported revision: identifiers and batches where applicable, notifications, cancellation, progress tokens, typed standard and MCP errors, required resultType, per-request protocol/capability metadata, trace context, and deterministic unsupported-version behavior. Malformed, duplicated, reordered, oversized, and adversarial messages fail predictably without corrupting another request. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
